reviews.text:
I really wanted to write a nice review after my dog's grooming, but unfortunately professionalism isn't a given. After a 40-minute drive, I was told my appointment HAD NOT BEEN BOOKED, even though I had a chat with them telling me the date and time. Nothing was done to accommodate a potential future client, despite the mistake being theirs. In fact, I was even treated with condescension.
This, to me, is synonymous with disorganization. That said, you won't see me again.
I don't know, I haven't been there and Google keeps suggesting I write a review.
My dog ​​is not very easy to treat 😅 so, for the first time, I only gave him a bath, but the guy who washed him is very sweet, competent and you can see that he loves his job and our puppies♥️ …
The staff is very friendly, we bought from their store and had a great time, especially their pieces. I'll be back often!
I brought my Poodle for the first time, super satisfied, courteous and professional staff, super stocked and very clean shop, I will definitely go back, thanks
